verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਣੁ ਨਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sun parataap kabeer dhaa dhoojaa sikh hoaa sain naiee|

en.bdb: Hearing of glory of Kabir, Sain also turned to be a disciple.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਕੈ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: prem bhagat raatee karai bhalakai raaj dhuaarai jaiee|

en.bdb: In the night he would immerse in loving devotion and in the morning he would serve at the door of the king.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਸੰਤ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: aae sa(n)t paraahune keeratan hoaa rain sabaiee|

en.bdb: On one night some sadhus came to him and the whole night was spent in singing the Lord's praises

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chhadd na sakai sa(n)t jan raaj dhuaar na sev kamaiee|

en.bdb: Sain could not leave company of the saints and consequently did not perform the king’s service the following morning.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੈਣ ਰੂਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਣੈ ਨੋ ਰੀਝਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sain roop har jai kai aaiaa raanai no reejhaiee|

en.bdb: God himself took the form of Sain. He served the king in such a way that the king was overjoyed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਨੋ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਰਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: saadh janaa(n) no vidhaa kar raaj dhuaar giaa saramaiee|

en.bdb: Bidding fairwell to the saints, Sain hesitantly arrived at the palace of the king.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਹੁੰ ਸਦਿ ਕੈ ਗਲਹੁੰ ਕਵਾਇ ਖੋਲਿ ਪੈਨ੍ਹਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: raanai dhoorahu(n) sadh kai galahu(n) kavai khol painhaiee|

en.bdb: The king From a distance the king called him nearby. He took off his own robes and offered them to Bhagat Sain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਹਉਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਜੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਣੈ ਲੁਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: vas keetaa hau(n) tudh aj bolai raajaa sunai lukaiee|

en.bdb: ‘You have overpowered me’, said the king and his words were heard by one and all.
God himself manifests the grandeur of the devotee.
